visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an exterior shot of the 'South-Link Medical Foundation Clinic' (Nan-Hui Clinic) on a bright day. The building is white-tiled, and two white cars are parked in front. A digital text overlay '2023 05 05' is centered on the screen. (2) Inside the clinic, the camera focuses on the reception desk. A television screen on the wall displays a man speaking. Two women are seen from behind, walking toward the reception area. (3) Dr. Hsu Chao-bin appears dressed in an elaborate 'Demon Slayer' Rengoku cosplay, complete with a yellow and red wig and a white cape. He holds a replica sword and laughs heartily with clinic staff and visitors in a well-lit hallway. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor courtyard where a group of people, including Dr. Hsu in his cosplay, are sitting at small wooden school-style desks arranged in a semi-circle, sharing a meal. The lighting is bright and natural. (5) In a series of shots, Dr. Hsu is seen in more casual attire, wearing a grey flat cap and a white button-up shirt. He is sitting in an outdoor cafe-style setting, talking and laughing animatedly with a woman with short hair. (6) A montage follows, showing Dr. Hsu in a kitchen wearing a white apron over medical scrubs. He is skillfully using a large wok to stir-fry vegetables with one hand, looking focused and proud. (7) Group photographs are shown in various settings: a dense green forest, a beach during the day, and at the finish line of a marathon event where many people are wearing athletic gear and holding signs. (8) Screenshots of a mobile messaging app (Line) are displayed, showing a conversation with 'Superman 徐超斌醫師'. The chat includes images of a chef's license and a portrait drawing. (9) Dr. Hsu is seen in a professional recording studio, wearing headphones and speaking into a large condenser microphone. His expression is calm and sincere. (10) The final shot is a beautiful wide angle of a blue sky filled with white clouds over a calm ocean. Large white subtitles appear, saying 'Goodbye, Dr. Hsu Chao-bin'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a light, airy acoustic guitar melody. The sound of distant birds and soft wind accompanies the visual of the clinic exterior. (2) As the interior is shown, the BGM continues, joined by the clear, rhythmic sound of a man's voice from the TV. Soft footsteps and the rustle of clothing are audible as people move. (3) A sudden burst of laughter and high-energy chatter occurs as Dr. Hsu interacts with others. The BGM remains bright and mid-tempo. (4) In the kitchen scene, the sharp sizzling sound of oil in a wok and the metallic 'clink' of a spatula against the pan dominate the audio, layered over the gentle BGM. (5) During the outdoor cafe interview, the voices of Dr. Hsu and a woman are central, characterized by warm tones and frequent chuckles. The ambient sound floor includes soft wind and distant city hum. (6) At the marathon, a loud 'pop' or gunshot marks the start, followed by the collective cheering and rhythmic footsteps of a crowd. (7) Towards the end, the BGM shifts to a more sentimental, slow-tempo piano piece. Dr. Hsu's voice in the recording studio is calm, resonant, and well-enunciated. (8) The video concludes with the piano melody fading out slowly against a background of peaceful wave sounds.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a touching tribute and memorial for Dr. Hsu Chao-bin, known as the 'Superman Doctor' of Taitung. It documents his vibrant personality, his diverse talents as a doctor, chef, and artist, and his unwavering dedication to his community, culminating in a poignant final goodbye.
